## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] Tests cover the new behaviour (written first where possible)
- [ ] Fixtures are synthetic: no real transcripts, logs, hostnames, IP addresses or keys
- [ ] README / CONTEXT.md / an ADR updated where behaviour, terms or decisions changed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under `## [Unreleased]`
- [ ] No change to persisted names (entry types, event kinds, ids, env vars), or the migration is included
- [ ] Any weakened defence in docs/security.md is called out above
